children: Norway energy solutions provider's Q3 revenue and EBITDA both missed analyst expectations
Order backlog at end of Q3 stood at NOK 69.3 bln
Company forecasts 2026 revenue of NOK 53-55 bln, with lower revenue expected in 2027
Aker Solutions sees 2026 revenue between NOK 53 bln and NOK 55 bln
Company expects 2026 EBITDA margin of 7.5% to 8.0% excluding SLB OneSubsea
Aker Solutions sees 2027 revenue falling to NOK 35 bln to NOK 40 bln
PROJECT MILESTONES - Co said meeting key project milestones contributed to Q3 performance, per CEO Paal Eikeseth
LIFE CYCLE SEGMENT - Strong operational performance in Life Cycle segment supported results
DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION - Co said ongoing digitalization and standardization efforts are improving efficiency
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil related services and equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Aker Solutions ASA is NOK40.00, about 4.8% above its October 27 closing price of NOK38.16
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
